messages:
incident-bot: [PAGE] SEV2 - model-routing error-rate spike in us-west2 (seen by canary) — frequent 502s and slow tail. Pager -> @nina.

nina: on it. quick glance at proxy logs shows `route_error: no available model replica` then retries. Pulling recent deploy and autoscaler events.

kevin: did we just push any routing config changes?

sophie: not in the last hour. I did a small config-as-code change 3h ago but it was only a logging tweak.

nina: rolling-update of model-pool-us-west2 happened 12m ago per deploy-bot. infra-bot: can you paste the rollout status?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout model-pool-us-west2 completed 12m ago, image: model-runtime-3.1.7. No failed pods on completion.

nina: hmmm. pulling `kubectl -n runtime get pods --field-selector=status.phase!=Running` -> shows 2 pods restarting after liveness check failures during readiness.

mike: that maps to when canary started 502s. Maybe new runtime has a transient initialization bug causing short unavailability, routing marked replicas unhealthy and retried -> 502s.

kevin: mitigation options: 1) pause traffic to the new pool (remove from LB) 2) revert rollout to previous image 3) increase probe timeouts for warmup. Which first?

nina: I'll drain traffic from pool to restore stability. Command: `rdwctl pool set-weight model-pool-us-west2 0 --reason "mitigate rollout instability"`

infra-bot: control-plane: pool weight set to 0 for model-pool-us-west2.

nina: p50/p95 latency back to normal for canary region. Good. A few customer requests hit tiny-fallback but overall success rate good.

kevin: are we seeing any user-facing error reports? Support?

sophie: CS ticket CS-1550 opened by support: a handful of users reported transient failures between 15:32-15:40 PT. Marked low-severity but flagging for incident note.

nina: ok handoff plan: I'll take an hour to confirm stability, then hand to omar for post-incident follow-ups. Handoff checklist below:```
- Verify pool weight remains 0: `rdwctl pool get model-pool-us-west2`
- Verify old image pool scaled back up or roll back completed
- Collect proxy logs to s3: `s3://rdw-logs/incidents/2134567890/`
- Confirm CS-1550 customer list and impacted requests
```

omar: I'll take followups after your watch. Please leave timeline notes here.

nina: timeline quick notes: 15:28 PT - rollout completed, 15:30 PT - canary 502s begin, 15:32 PT - paging triggered, 15:34 PT - pool weight set to 0, 15:38 PT - stability restored, 15:45 PT - pager cleared.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: noted that two pods had repeated failing readiness checks due to `model-init timeout` in logs.

kevin: tentative root cause: aggressive readiness probe + slower model spinup in new runtime leading to brief replica unavailability and routing retries.

omar: actions to track: A1: Add warmup window to readiness probe for this runtime (owner: eng-runtime) A2: Add rollout gate to require X healthy minutes in canary before shifting 100% (owner: eng-sre) A3: Add a short-circuit to routing to prefer existing healthy pools over newly rolled ones for Y minutes (owner: eng-platform) A4: Update runbook to include this exact drain step and commands (owner: eng-oncall) A5: CS followup: notify affected customers and confirm no data loss (owner: support).

kevin: also recommend an integration test that simulates slow model init in staging to catch this. I'll pair with eng-ml. Mark as A6 (owner: eng-ml).

omar: I'm creating the post-incident writeup and action tracker. Doc link: https://redwood.internal/postincidents/2134567890 (please add logs and any notes). Target: first draft by tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

sophie: I'll attach CS-1550 thread and list affected user ids.

nina: leaving handoff now. Omar, please confirm you have everything and take owner of the doc.

omar: I have it. I'll assign reviewers: nina, kevin, sophie, mike. Internal review window 48h.

kevin: brown-bag proposal: "Safe Rollouts & Model Warmup" - 30m walkthrough with runbook demo + `rdwctl` emergency steps. Propose Fri Jun 11 09:00 PT.

omar: sounds good. I'll schedule and include a short ops drill. Add agenda: 1) incident timeline 2) root cause 3) demo of drain and rollback commands 4) planned mitigations and action owners 5) Q&A / rehearsal.

infra-bot: note: autoscaler metrics were healthy during this incident. No signs of scale down/up interplay.

mike: small FYI: I captured pod logs and uploaded them: s3://rdw-logs/incidents/2134567890/pods.tar.gz

omar: adding A7: add a CI test that runs readiness-probe fuzzing during runtime image integration (owner: ci-team).

nina: thanks all. Followups noted. I'll be available if anything pops during the doc drafting.

incident-bot: [CLOSEOUT] Pager cleared - no further error spikes for 20m.

omar: closing thread for active mitigation. Post-incident doc + brown-bag scheduling in progress. Ping here for any late findings.

kevin: +1. End of thread.
